questions.stem: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: The subject acting on itself
A second person receiving the action
A passive meaning with no agent
An impersonal construction

stimulus.body: Dans un exercice de français, le professeur demande de choisir la forme qui convient d'après la règle de la leçon.

questions.stem: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: la machine, because it receives the action
There is no agent in this sentence
options.misconception: treats "There is no agent in this sentence" as if it followed from the evidence

options.text: est reparee, because it is the verb
le technicien, introduced by par

questions.explanation: The agent is le technicien, introduced by par. The key is D, "le technicien, introduced by par". Option A ("la machine, because it receives the action") is wrong: confuses patient and agent. Option B ("There is no agent in this sentence") is wrong: treats "There is no agent in this sentence" as if it followed from the evidence. Option C ("est reparee, because it is the verb") is wrong: gives the verb agent status.
questions.hint: Look for par.

Option C ("departir, because the spelling matches") is wrong: treats "departir, because the spelling matches" as if it followed from the evidence. questions.topic: The reflexive use of a pronominal verb
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish reflexive in a stimulus

stimulus.body: Dans un exercice de français, le professeur demande de choisir la forme qui convient d'après la règle de la leçon.

questions.stem: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: The first is transitive and the second reflexive
options.misconception: substitutes a familiar but inapplicable case for the relation the passage establishes

options.text: The first is reflexive and the second transitive
Both are reflexive
Both are transitive

questions.explanation: The first is reflexive and the second transitive. The key is B, "The first is reflexive and the second transitive". Option A ("The first is transitive and the second reflexive") is wrong: substitutes a familiar but inapplicable case for the relation the passage establishes. Option C ("Both are reflexive") is wrong: misses the transitive case. Option D ("Both are transitive") is wrong: misses the reflexive case.
questions.hint: Check whether se appears.

questions.subject: FRENCH
questions.topic: The middle-voice use, where se names no second person
questions.learningObjective: Distinguish middle voice in a stimulus

stimulus.body: Dans un exercice de français, le professeur demande de choisir la forme qui convient d'après la règle de la leçon.

questions.stem: Quelle réponse applique correctement la règle de la leçon ?

options.text: Both are middle voice
Both are reflexive
se ferme is middle voice and se lave is reflexive
se ferme is passive and se lave is middle

questions.explanation: Se ferme' is middle voice and 'se lave' is reflexive. The key is C, "se ferme is middle voice and se lave is reflexive". Option A ("Both are middle voice") is wrong: misses the reflexive case. Option B ("Both are reflexive") is wrong: misses the middle-voice case. Option D ("se ferme is passive and se lave is middle") is wrong: confuses the voices.
questions.hint: Middle voice has no second person.
